objective: Improve fish/diver fidelity with at most 10% per-clip complete-file growth over the frozen ordinary GLC baseline; compare against original GLC and nonsemantic controls at the same budget.

scope.first_route: frozen SegFormer + one sender background low-pass operator + unchanged GLC/receiver
scope.D0_authorized_work: CPU data, annotation, timestamp and protocol preparation

data.vfr_policy: Keep actual PTS; static localization is available, timed codec comparison waits for an explicit PTS-preserving path. Never reinterpret average frame rate as constant.
data.reference: unaltered publisher RGB at original dimensions; never preprocessed input or lossy preview
data.GT_usage: offline evaluation and optional oracle diagnostic; never predictor/production sender input

controls.C: predicted target protection + identical Gaussian low-pass outside protection + same GLC
controls.O_optional: GT protection diagnostic; not deployable performance or a guaranteed upper bound
controls.D1_deliverable: Freeze one prediction model, threshold and protection margin on development data before D2. Do not add extra modules to meet an innovation quota.
controls.A_anchor: Original RGB GLC at fixed q=32 defines S0 before semantic results; ordinary GLC also gets the same B0/B10 budget opportunity as C.

codec.selection: Largest measured S_total within the selected B0 or B10 ceiling; ties use lower q. Choose by size only, never GT or quality. Reuse cached points across both ceilings.
codec.unmatched_policy: The three fixed q points may not match size; report insufficient rate matching, not semantic-method failure. Any additional candidates require a versioned bounded protocol before execution.

byte_accounting.S_total: actual complete glcv + required side information and per-clip control metadata
byte_accounting.preinstalled_models: deployment size recorded separately; any per-clip model delta counts in S_total
byte_accounting.mechanism_budget: S0 = actual complete transmission bytes of original-input A at q=32 on exactly the same frames, dimensions and true timeline; register configuration and baseline file hash before semantic results.

near_equal_pair.role: Strict reporting category, not an eligibility gate for all practical results within the 10% cap.
near_equal_pair.X_means: Actual A or B comparator selected under the same ceiling, not necessarily the immutable A@q32 anchor.

byte_accounting.unmatched_points: Report actual complete sizes, growth versus S0, quality and matching limitations. No near-equal label without its inequality. No hidden resolution or timeline changes, padding or interpolated fake streams.

hard_file_growth_limit.static_images: Use same-image ordinary GLC A@q32 as S0; report bytes separately without inventing duration.

categories.over_limit: 10 * S_semantic > 11 * S0; diagnostic only, not an accepted deliverable

comparison_ceilings.more_bytes_than_comparator: Report a size/quality tradeoff; do not attribute all improvement to semantics merely because both outputs are within B10.
comparison_ceilings.required_control: Always report ordinary GLC under the same ceiling, especially B10. Beating A@q32 alone does not demonstrate semantic net benefit.

link_scenarios_and_rate_reporting.units: Decimal: 1 kbps = 1000 bit/s; count full transmitted application files, not just neural payload.
link_scenarios_and_rate_reporting.below_reference_range: No minimum rate and no padding required.
link_scenarios_and_rate_reporting.above_reference_range: Report explicitly; satisfying relative growth alone does not establish application-rate feasibility.

legacy_D0_scenario.claim: Separate deployment feasibility check; equal-byte semantic benefit does not establish this link target or real acoustic transmission.
legacy_D0_scenario.role: Historical D0 link scenario only; not a hard D1/D2 quality-experiment gate.

evaluation.D1: GT pixel precision/recall/IoU; instance coverage by target size; protection area and no-target false protection. Missing detections remain in denominator. Check missed small fish/divers, mask flicker, target exits and excessive protection area on continuous clips; static diver images do not establish temporal behavior.
evaluation.D2_primary_numeric: Per-clip pooled RGB MSE/PSNR over independent original GT target pixels; each clip has equal weight in the reported mean. Fish and diver scores separate.
evaluation.MSE: sum((decoded_RGB - original_RGB)^2 on GT region and 3 channels) / (3 * GT pixel count)
evaluation.PSNR: 10*log10(255^2/MSE); zero MSE reported as lossless with MSE=0, empty region reported NA
evaluation.background: GT complement is rest-of-image, not necessarily semantic water or exhaustively labeled background. Report it separately.
evaluation.visual: Hide method names, randomize left/right, compare at same size/time and same crops against original RGB. Record better/tie/worse, missed targets, flicker, ghosting and background loss. Single user assessment is exploratory.
evaluation.temporal: Continuous playback on verified PTS only; no temporal score inferred from still images or frame-independent averages.
evaluation.failure_policy: Keep all failures; separate localization, preprocessing and size-matching failures. No automatic training or threshold relaxation after holdout.

budget_and_attribution.practical_result: Check the hard per-clip 10% cap and report gain versus immutable A@q32, with same-ceiling A/B results alongside it.
budget_and_attribution.controlled_gain: Apply the retained numeric/visual engineering thresholds against same-ceiling A/B controls; report actual size mismatches and restrict causal attribution accordingly.
budget_and_attribution.near_equal_claim: Use the strict near_equal_pair rule against each comparator. A larger C is not an equal-volume semantic result.

provenance.reason: User accepts 30-40 kbps as a file-rate reference and caps complete-file growth at 10%; 20 kbps was a link-speed assumption.
provenance.run_record_rule: Record both the unchanged D0 ready_manifest hash and this protocol hash. Do not rewrite historical D0 protocol hashes.
